business_summary: Dish TV India Limited provides direct to home (DTH) television and teleport services in India. The company offers connected devices, such as Dish SMRT Hub and VZY Smart TVs; and value-added services, including movie on demand/pay-per-view, regional content, as well as active and multilingual services. It also provides programming, live TV, and user-generated content through Watcho platform; FLIQS which provides films, web series, and short-form videos; and Zing Super Device, a two-in-one device that merges pay TV channels with a free-to-air package. In addition, the company offers B2B and technology services comprising order management, Shopzop, teleport, and infra support services. Further, it provides set-top-boxes, dish antennas, and low-noise boxes; and customer-related services, such as call centre support and repair services. The company distributes its products and services through a network of distributors and dealers. It provides DTH services under Dish TV, Zing Super, and D2H brands. Dish TV India Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Noida, India.
